dossiers.title: Fallout: New Vegas
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Branching Mojave quests and competing factions support substantially different political and moral resolutions, often praised on repeat playthroughs.
Skill-checked dialogue, faction standing and non-combat approaches give the courier more ways to resolve objectives than shooting alone.
Character attributes and skills affect weapons, dialogue, economy and the range of role-playing routes.
Open-world exploration, desert settlements, casinos and optional tasks make detours a major part of the campaign.
Players describe crashes and startup instability, and different technical workarounds are discussed; the extent of current reliability remains unresolved.
The exact PCR regional edition draws objections to its separate community presence and reports of mod-manager incompatibility.
Detailed faction writing and characters are praised alongside acknowledgments that the older engine and presentation show their age.
A dated Russian-language report describes Russian base-game text but English-language separately purchased DLC; present distribution is unknown.
The open-ended faction and side-quest structure creates player-directed pacing rather than a strictly linear adventure.

conflicts.statement: Players praise player-choice freedom but criticize crashes and region-specific mod friction in the PCR edition.

dossiers.title: Brutal Legend
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: The game mixes third-person axe combat and guitar powers with large RTS-style Stage Wars battles, which split player opinion.
Heavy-metal music, art direction, humor and colorful characters receive praise from players with differing views of the gameplay.
A metal-themed open world connects driving, collectibles, short secondary missions and scripted battles.
The main story is relatively short and later dramatic beats move quickly, while lengthy strategy encounters may interrupt the action rhythm.
Stage Wars demands unit orders, resource control and direct hero combat, but complaints concern difficulty spikes and non-intuitive RTS controls.
New guitar abilities, combat moves, allied troops and vehicle customization broaden tactical options during the journey.
Some players find secondary tasks and later strategy battles repetitive despite enjoying the setting.
Stage battles also frame competitive strategy play, unlike a straightforward cooperative campaign.
One Russian player reported a controller-recognition problem in 2023 and a Big Picture workaround, while another reported their Xbox controller worked without it.

conflicts.statement: Players disagree on the real-time-strategy shift: it can be a distinctive highlight or an unwelcome obstacle to enjoying the action adventure.

dossiers.title: Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 10 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: First-person melee blocking, dodges and ranged tools combine against swarms and special Skaven enemies in hectic four-player missions.
The five distinct heroes supply complementary equipment and team roles, making human coordination especially valuable at higher difficulties.
Dice, tomes, grimoires and mission rewards drive equipment upgrades and repeated runs, but introduce randomness and optimization friction.
Higher difficulties reward coordinated positioning and dealing quickly with special rats; separated groups and poorly equipped bots struggle.
Players report AI companions sometimes fail to revive them or carry loot objectives, leaving solo-with-bots runs more restricted.
Objective-driven missions around Ubersreik are intended to be replayed rather than forming a branching campaign or free-roaming adventure.
Hero equipment and difficulty vary repeated missions, though repeated loot runs can feel grind-heavy.
Matchmaking supports four-player squads, with bots taking empty slots, but optional loot mechanics and difficult missions rely more on human coordination.
Russian-language release-era players described confusion about enabling Russian interface language; those 2015 reports do not resolve present behavior.
The Warhammer dark-fantasy setting and visceral cooperative rat-fighting experience are recurring strengths even when progression draws criticism.

conflicts.statement: Demanding co-op combat and role synergy are praised, while bots and repeated reward runs create friction.
